steps.label: Round 3
steps.instruction: Work 47 more rows in double stockinette stitch while following the color chart for your size (rounds 2-48).

chart.text: k9 A, k2 B, k25 A, k2 B, k9 A, k2 B, k25 A, k2 B, k9 A
chart.written: k9 A, k2 B, k25 A, k2 B, k9 A, k2 B, k25 A, k2 B, k9 A

related.title: Working the chart
related.text: Each block is one double-knit pair: K the st in the block's color, then P the next st in the opposite color. "k9 A" means 9 pairs.

source.quote: Work 47 more rows in double stockinette stitch while following the color

steps.label: Round 50 (decrease round)
steps.instruction: Decrease round: work ROUND 50 of the color chart, working STEPS 2-6 at each marker to end of round. 75 sts of each color remain (150 total).

chart.text: k14 A, CDD A, k3 A, k4 B, k7 A, CDD A, k14 A, CDD A, k7 A, k4 B, k3 A, CDD A, k14 A, CDD A (with the round's first st)
chart.written: k18 A, k4 B, k30 A, k4 B, k19 A

related.title: CDD A (decrease pair)
related.text: Rearrange the next 3 K and 3 P sts into 3 K then 3 P; work a CDD on the K sts and a CDDp on the P sts; move the hanging marker up. 3 pairs become 1, in the color shown.

related.title: The round's first stitch
related.text: The first stitch carries the hanging marker; skip it at the start and work it into the last decrease at the end of the round.

source.quote: ROUND 50 - 75 (85) sts of each color remain
